setting_ko: 처음 와 본 도시에서 메인 스트리트와 2번가가 만나는 모퉁이, 약국 앞에 서 있습니다. 오크 스트리트 450번지에 있는 리버사이드 공공도서관에 가려고 합니다.

facts.current_location: The corner of Main Street and 2nd Avenue, in front of a pharmacy
facts.walking_route: Walk two blocks north on Main Street to Oak Street, turn left onto Oak Street, and walk one more block; the library is on the right, across from Oak Street Park
facts.landmarks: There is a post office on the corner of Main Street and Oak Street; the library is a red brick building with a clock tower
facts.bus_option: Bus 12 from the stop in front of the pharmacy goes two stops to Oak Street; the fare is $2.00
facts.library_hours: The library is open until 8:00 p.m. today
facts.nearby_cafe: A coffee shop called Bean There is next to the post office
facts.limits: The passerby knows this neighborhood well but does not know other parts of the city

opening_line.en: Hi there, you look a little lost. Can I help you find something?
opening_line.ko: 안녕하세요, 길을 헤매시는 것 같네요. 찾으시는 곳 있으면 도와드릴까요?

goals.en: Ask how to get to the library
Repeat the directions back to check them
Ask the person to repeat or explain something

allowed_flow: Offer help and ask where the traveler wants to go.
Give walking directions only from the facts, in order, using street names and landmarks.
If asked, give the walking time, the bus option, or the library hours from the facts.
If the traveler repeats the directions correctly, confirm it; if they make a mistake, gently correct only the wrong part.
When asked to repeat, say it again more simply or in smaller steps.
If asked about places not in the facts, say you are not sure and suggest checking a map or asking at the library.
End with a friendly goodbye once the traveler is confident about the route.

easy.guidance_en: Give one step per sentence with an easy landmark for each step. Say left and right instead of compass directions, and use simple words.

normal.guidance_en: Give directions in two or three steps with street names and one landmark, then check whether the traveler got it.

hard.guidance_en: Give the route in one go with casual phrasing such as 'hang a left' or 'you can't miss it', including compass directions and landmarks. Simplify only if the traveler asks.

hints.ko: 가고 싶은 곳을 말하고 가는 길을 물어보세요.
hints.example_en: Excuse me, how do I get to the Riverside Public Library?

hints.ko: 걸어서 갈 수 있는지, 얼마나 걸리는지 물어볼 수 있어요.
hints.example_en: Is it close enough to walk?

hints.ko: 들은 길을 순서대로 다시 말해 보세요.
hints.example_en: So I go two blocks and turn left onto Oak Street, right?

hints.ko: 잘 못 들었으면 다시, 천천히 말해 달라고 부탁하세요.
hints.example_en: Sorry, could you say that again a little more slowly?
Sorry, which way is north from here?

model_expressions.en: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the Riverside Public Library?
model_expressions.ko: 실례합니다, 리버사이드 공공도서관 가는 길 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

model_expressions.en: Is there a bus that goes there?
Let me make sure I've got this: two blocks north, then left on Oak Street?
model_expressions.ko: 제가 제대로 이해했는지 확인해 볼게요. 북쪽으로 두 블록, 그다음 오크 스트리트에서 왼쪽이죠?

model_expressions.en: So the library will be on my right, across from the park?
model_expressions.ko: 그러니까 도서관은 공원 맞은편, 제 오른쪽에 있는 거죠?

model_expressions.en: Sorry, could you say that one more time?
model_expressions.ko: 죄송한데, 한 번만 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?

model_expressions.en: What does the building look like?
When you say the corner, do you mean the one with the post office?
model_expressions.ko: 모퉁이라고 하신 게 우체국 있는 모퉁이 말씀이세요?

reading.en: Excuse me, is the library far from here?
Go straight for two blocks and turn left.
reading.ko: 두 블록 직진한 다음 왼쪽으로 도세요.

reading.en: The library is across from the park.
Which bus should I take to Oak Street?
reading.ko: 오크 스트리트에 가려면 어느 버스를 타야 하나요?

shadowing.en: Could you point me in the right direction?
shadowing.ko: 어느 쪽으로 가야 하는지 알려 주시겠어요?

shadowing.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that last part.
Thanks a lot, I really appreciate your help.

free_answer.question_en: Explain how to get from your home to the nearest subway station or bus stop.
free_answer.question_ko: 집에서 가장 가까운 지하철역이나 버스 정류장까지 가는 길을 설명해 보세요.
free_answer.sample_answer_en: When you leave my building, turn right and walk straight for about five minutes. At the convenience store, turn left. The subway entrance is right there, next to a bakery.

free_answer.question_en: You're lost in a new city and your phone battery is dead. What would you say to someone on the street?
free_answer.question_ko: 낯선 도시에서 길을 잃었는데 휴대폰 배터리가 꺼졌어요. 길에서 만난 사람에게 뭐라고 말할까요?
free_answer.sample_answer_en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. My phone just died and I'm a little lost. Could you tell me how to get to the train station from here?
